crossRefs.note: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons…

people.name: Enoch
people.line: A righteous man who walked with God.

people.name: Jared
people.line: Ancestor of Noah; father of Enoch

translations.web: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
translations.asv: and Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
